# Level-1 fixed vectors, IPv4 -> IPv6 (plan §3 WU1, §11). Read by
# tests/diff_engine.rs. One vector per line; `#` starts a comment.
#
# hex <name> <input frame> <expected output frame>
#   Core only, against an independent from-scratch reference with full
#   (not incremental) checksums. Session: the spike's, reversed:
#   203.0.113.5 port 53 -> pool 198.51.100.10 port 61000, translated to
#   64:ff9b::203.0.113.5 port 53 -> 2001:db8::10 port 40000; ingress MAC
#   cc:cc:cc:cc:cc:cc; FIB smac 02:00:00:00:01:01, dmac 02:00:00:00:01:fe;
#   ipv6_mtu 1500, lowest_ipv6_mtu 1280, copy_tos on. Input IPv4 ID
#   0x1234, DF = 1 unless the name says df0.
#
# case <name> key=value ...
#   Differential against the full plat-nat64 engine, as in v6_to_v4.txt.
#   Keys as there, with hop as the IPv4 TTL, tc as the IPv4 TOS, and df
#   (1). The session is created by an outbound packet first.
hex in_5b_payload ccccccccccccdddddddddddd080045000021123440004011c254cb007105c633640a0035ee48000d674068656c6c6f 0200000001fe02000000010186dd60000000000d113e0064ff9b0000000000000000cb00710520010db800000000000000000000001000359c40000db5bd68656c6c6f
hex in_1300b_df  
hex in_3b_odd_length_df0 ccccccccccccdddddddddddd08004500001f1234000009113957cb007105c633640a0035ee48000be6b3616263 0200000001fe02000000010186dd60000000000b11070064ff9b0000000000000000cb00710520010db800000000000000000000001000359c40000b3531616263
hex in_tos_copied_to_tc ccccccccccccdddddddddddd080045b90021123440004011c19bcb007105c633640a0035ee48000d674068656c6c6f 0200000001fe02000000010186dd6b900000000d113e0064ff9b0000000000000000cb00710520010db800000000000000000000001000359c40000db5bd68656c6c6f
hex in_ethernet_padding_60 ccccccccccccdddddddddddd08004500001c123440004011c259cb007105c633640a0035ee480008ab1c000000000000000000000000000000000000 0200000001fe02000000010186dd600000000008113e0064ff9b0000000000000000cb00710520010db800000000000000000000001000359c400008f999
hex in_csum_input_ffff ccccccccccccdddddddddddd080045000024123440004011c251cb007105c633640a0035ee480010ffff656467652d69b0d9 0200000001fe02000000010186dd600000000010113e0064ff9b0000000000000000cb00710520010db800000000000000000000001000359c4000104e7d656467652d69b0d9
hex in_csum_output_ffff ccccccccccccdddddddddddd080045000024123440004011c251cb007105c633640a0035ee480010b182656467652d6fff50 0200000001fe02000000010186dd600000000010113e0064ff9b0000000000000000cb00710520010db800000000000000000000001000359c400010ffff656467652d6fff50

# lowest_ipv6_mtu ± 1 (RFC 7915 §4): with DF = 0 the slow path fragments
# anything above it; with DF = 1 only ipv6_mtu applies.
case lowest6_minus_1_df0 payload=1231 df=0 expect=redirect
case lowest6_exact_df0 payload=1232 df=0 expect=redirect
case lowest6_plus_1_df0 payload=1233 df=0 expect=too_big
case lowest6_minus_1_df1 payload=1231 df=1 expect=redirect
case lowest6_exact_df1 payload=1232 df=1 expect=redirect
case lowest6_plus_1_df1 payload=1233 df=1 expect=redirect

# ipv6_mtu ± 1 (DF = 1: the slow path sends Frag Needed above it).
case mtu6_minus_1 payload=1451 expect=redirect
case mtu6_exact payload=1452 expect=redirect
case mtu6_plus_1 payload=1453 expect=too_big
# ipv6_mtu = lowest_ipv6_mtu = 1400 with DF = 0.
case mtu6_1400_exact_df0 mtu6=1400 lowest6=1400 payload=1352 df=0 expect=redirect
case mtu6_1400_plus_1_df0 mtu6=1400 lowest6=1400 payload=1353 df=0 expect=too_big

# TUN MTU ± 1 (ipv6_mtu raised so it does not decide first).
case tun_mtu_exact mtu6=1600 link_mtu=1600 payload=1472 expect=redirect
case tun_mtu_plus_1 mtu6=1600 link_mtu=1600 payload=1473 expect=too_big
# Egress link MTU below the packet: bpf_fib_lookup FRAG_NEEDED.
case link_mtu_plus_1 link_mtu=1400 payload=1353 expect=fib_frag_needed
case link_mtu_exact link_mtu=1400 payload=1352 expect=redirect

# Two-hop TTL model.
case ttl_255 hop=255 expect=redirect
case ttl_3 hop=3 expect=redirect
case ttl_2 hop=2 expect=hop_limit
case ttl_1 hop=1 expect=hop_limit
case ttl_0 hop=0 expect=hop_limit

# TOS: copied with copy_tos, 0 without.
case tos_copied tc=185 expect=redirect
case tos_cleared tc=185 copy_tos=0 expect=redirect

# RFC 1624 / RFC 768 checksum edges.
case csum_input_ffff payload=8 csum=in_ffff expect=redirect
case csum_output_ffff payload=8 csum=out_ffff expect=redirect
case csum_output_ffff_odd payload=9 csum=out_ffff expect=redirect
case empty_payload payload=0 expect=redirect

# RFC 6052 §2.2 / §2.4 example prefixes /32 ... /96 (the new IPv6 source).
case rfc6052_32 prefix=2001:db8::/32 expect=redirect
case rfc6052_40 prefix=2001:db8:100::/40 expect=redirect
case rfc6052_48 prefix=2001:db8:122::/48 expect=redirect
case rfc6052_56 prefix=2001:db8:122:300::/56 expect=redirect
case rfc6052_64 prefix=2001:db8:122:344::/64 expect=redirect
case rfc6052_96 prefix=2001:db8:122:344::/96 expect=redirect
